message.reasoning:
The user wants to check different options for booking flight 1234? Actually they say "I need to arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking number 1234, and want to check different options." They want to calculate from the available list's first airport to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class ticket price. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get list of all airports. Then get flight cost from first to last on 2024-10-31 business class. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what about booking? They mention booking number 1234. Maybe we need to cancel existing booking? Or just compute cost? They want to "arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking number 1234". That might mean they want to book a new flight under booking id 1234? But booking id is usually assigned after booking. So maybe they want to cancel booking 1234? Not sure.

They want to check different options. They want to compute cost. Provide estimated total payable amount. We need to compute cost in USD. Then maybe add insurance? Not specified. So just provide cost.

We need to call get_all_credit_cards? No. We need to get flight cost. So call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=last airport code, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business.

But we need access token. We need to authenticate. We need client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have those. We can call travel_get_login_status to see if logged in. Let's call travel_get_login_status.
